title: Placement Aptitude Quiz - Day 6
description: Test your aptitude, logical reasoning, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills.

questions.question: If 15 workers can complete a task in 20 days, how many days will 25 workers take to complete the same task?
Find the next number in the series: 7, 14, 28, 56, ?
A train travels 240 km in 4 hours. What is its average speed?
Which number is the odd one out?
If all roses are flowers and some flowers are red, which statement is definitely true?
A shopkeeper buys an item for ₹800 and sells it for ₹920. Find the profit percentage.
Find the missing term: D, H, L, P, ?
A clock shows 3:15. What is the angle between the hour and minute hands?
A father is 30 years older than his son. If the son's age is 12 years, what will be the father's age after 8 years?
A basket contains 5 red, 4 blue, and 3 green balls. What is the minimum number of balls to pick to guarantee at least one ball of each color?

correct.question: A father is three times as old as his son. After 10 years, he will be twice as old. What is the son's present age?
